rows.text: The LDP's history page for the 海部俊樹 presidency says the presidential selection of 平成元年八月八日 (8 August 1989), held after the announced resignation of the 宇野 cabinet (宇野内閣の退陣表明), took place at the joint plenary meeting of party Diet members in place of a convention by the votes of Diet members and local delegates; of the three candidates (林義郎, 海部俊樹, 石原慎太郎) 海部候補 won a majority.
The same sentence says 海部候補 became the 14th president (第十四代総裁に就任しました).

The same paragraph says that because the new president's term carried on the predecessor's term to the end of October, the presidential election was notified on 十月六日 (6 October 1989) and 海部総裁 was the only candidate and was elected (候補者は海部総裁一名であり当選).
It adds that the result was reported to the 51st extraordinary party convention on 十月三十一日 (31 October 1989) and 海部総裁's reappointment (再任) was decided.

The page closes by saying 海部総裁 took responsibility for the scrapping of the political reform bills and declined to stand (立候補を辞退) in the presidential election scheduled for 平成三年十月 (October 1991) on the expiry of his term (任期満了).

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the LDP president (総裁) for CLAUDE-C01-18 only, 1990-2009 (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-13). Party elections and selections (member and Diet-member votes, joint plenary meetings of party Diet members), notices, candidacies, declarations and reports of results, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced and prospective resignations, predecessor references and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a filing, a schedule, an unnamed caption or a meeting). The prime-ministership (jp_pm) is excluded: no row feeds it, and no jp_pm claim feeds this office.
